text: Ne matan dumma dumma ooso eriza hiillati deettes; shuch qerizaytinne massizayti, anaaxetinne ubba ooso ooththanaas dandayza hiillati deettes.
Muse nayti Gershoomenne El7ezeere.
«Ta eriza mala tani ta wozinara sidhiza miishshi baa; gido attiin hessa guussi ta bolla mooroy baa» guus gidenna. Buro ta bolla pirdanay Godaa.

Xoossi Woosa Keeththa giddon koyro Hawaareta, nam7anththo qasse nabeta, heedzdzanththo astamaareta, kaaleththidi malaata ooththizayta, paththiza imoteththi dizayta, haratakka as maaddiza imotay dizayta, dere ayso erateththi dizaytanne dumma dumma qaala haasayana imoteththi diza asata woththides.
Nabeta naytappe issoy GODAA qaalas azazettidi ba laggeza, «Tana shoca» gides; gido attiin laggezi shocontta ixxides.
Asheeri misle GODAA Keeththafe kessidi Yerusalaameppe karera diza gede Qediroone shoobba efidi heen xuuggides; gaacci liiqisidi deraa duufon laallides.
Hessafe guye Yuhuda asay Kebroone yides. Heen Dawite tiydi Yuhuda deraa bolla kawoththida. Gala7aade deren Yaabuse asay Sa7oole ahaa moogidayssa Dawites yootiin,
«Isra7eele naytas, ‹Ta mala nabe Xoossi intte giddofe denththana› gidayssi hayssa Musekko!
Phexroosikka qasho keeththaafe iza kaalli kezides; gido attiin izas agumo be7izaa misatides attiin kiitanchchazi ooththizayssi tumu gididayssa eribeenna.
Phawuloosinne Barnabaasi asay istta ixxidayssa bessanaas ba toho bolla diza gudulla pittidi Iqoniyoone geetettizaso bida.
Banara gam7ana mala istti oychchiin izi, «Akkay» giidi ixxides.
Hessika Efesoonen diza Ayhudata achchaninne Girike asa ubbaa achchan erettiin wurikka babbida; hessankka Godaa Yesusa sunththi bonchchettides.
iza aaway heytappe issaaka ooththontta aggiko, naazi zumbullata bolla yarshos shiiqidayssa miikko, ba laggeza machcheyra laymatikko,
«Hanne Oholibee! Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Ne ixxada isttafe sher7i gida ne laggeththota ta ne bolla denththana; isttaka ubbaa baggafe ta ne bolla ehana.
Aggaara Abraames attuma naa yeladus; Abraamey Aggaara yelida naaza Isma7eele gi sunththides.
Laabay, «Ha keelay neeppenne taappe giddon hach markka» gides; hessa gishshas iza sunththay Gal7eede geetettides.
Histtiin he biittays godaa gidida addezi nuna, ‹Intte ammanettiza as gididayssa tani hayssan erana; intte ishatappe issaa haan ta achchan yeggidi gafida intte soo asaas kath ekki biite.
Izi ba ayfeso meecetti simmi kezidi barkka bana minththeththidi, «Quma haa aaththite!» gides.

Hessa gishshas GODAY Yuhuda ayssiza Salatiyaale naa Zerubaabele, qeeseta halaqa Iyosaadoqe naa Iyaasonne di7eteththafe shemppora paxa simmida dereza ubbaa wozina denththeththides. Asaykka yiidi ba GODAA Ubbaafe Wolqqama Xoossa keeth keexo doommides.
Haggey qasseka, «Aha bochchidi tunida asi heytappe issaa bochchiko he boshettida kaththay tunandee?» gi oychchiin qeesetikka, «Ee tunana» giidi zaarida.
Ba ammano kaddida asata istta maaroteththan wostti zoranee? He asati poo7oy isttas issito poo7idayta salo imoteththaa ekki be7idayta, Xillo Ayana ekki be7idayta,
Intteno Isra7eele asazoo! Intte keehippe makkallidayssaako simmite.
Ta giththa mashshay salota giddon baas gidana gakkanaas uyadus; be7ite; Eedoome bolla, tani qanggida asaa bolla pirdanaas wodhdhadus.
Istta ooso mala hanqo ba baalgaaratas, pirda ba morkketas izi qanxxana. Haruro biittatas istta ooso ooso mala immana.
Gidikkoka abeet GODAWU, neni nuus aawa; nuni urqqata; neni nuna medhdhidayssa; nuni ubbayka ne kushen medhettidayta.
Nu wurikka daro miishshan dhuphettoos. Haasayan dhuphettonttaadey diikko izi ba asateth lo7eththi naaganaas dandayza kumeththa asa.
Seekeeme asay amarda asaa dooridi zuma hu7en Abimelekke wodhanaas zamadi uttana mala ooththides; he uttidayti ogera kanththiza asaa ubbaa bonqqida; Abimelekkeykka hessa ubbaa siyides.
Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay, «Intte xuuggi shiishshiza yarshoza gidiin hara yarshotara gujjidi ashozara inttes miite.
Hessa gishshas GODAY tana, «Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay inttena, ‹Uyite; maththottite; cooyite nam7anththo intte dendontta mala ta intte giddo yeddiza olaa sinththan kundite› gees.
Xoossi ba hu7es Ayana; iza goynnizayti ayananinne tuman goynnanaas bessees» gides.
Hayssi alamey pirdettana wodey hayssa; hayssa dereza haariza Xala7ey ha7i gede kare yegettana.
Ne tana denththada carko bolla woththadasa; izi tana yuushshana malakka ooththadasa; gote carkoyka tana shirechchi shirechchi yeggees.

«Ne isttas, ‹Isra7eele naytappe gidiin woykko isttara diza hara dere as gidiin Dunkaaneza pengefe attiin harason awanka GODAAS xuugettiza yarsho woykko hara yarsho yarshiko hessaadey GODAA deretara qoodettanaas bessenna› ga yoota.
« ‹Qeeseso as gidonttaadey oonikka erontta dishe GODAAS dummatidi imettida miish miikko he izi midayssa kumeththa wogaa xeetappe nam7u kushe gujjidi qeesezas qanxxo.
«Nohe wode hanidayssa mala Asa Naa wodenkka hessaththo hanana.
Gido attiin tani dendidaappe guye inttefe sinththatada Galila baana» gides.
issifeteththa yarshos 2 boorata, 5 dharshota, 5 deysha orgetanne layth kumida 5 dharsho laaqqata; heyti wuri Amihuude naa Elshama yarshota.
Ta bolla dendida iita asata bolla tani hayssa ubbaa ooththana; hayssa bazzozan ubbatikka wuri wurana; ubbatikka hayqqana; tani GODAY hayssa yootadis› ga yoota.»
Intte siiqoy erateththaninne akeekan keehi darana mala ta woossays.
Ushach hadirsi gooppa; ne toho iitappe naaga.
Asi iitateththan eqqidi minni kanththanawu dandayenna; xilloti gidikko ba dizasoppe qaaxxettenna.
Azazo naagizay ba shemppo naagees; gido attiin izo ixxizaadey hayqqees.
Mooranchchati geella ogera hemetteettes; gido attiin geeshshati suure haneettes.
Nena uufidi ixxontta mala ne lagge soo ubbato booppa.
GODAY iza naagidi paxa woththees; izikka biitta bolla anjjettana; GODAY iza morkketas iza aaththidi immenna.
istti ta woththida maara moorikko, ta azazokka bonchchontta ixxiko,
GODAA galatite; iza sunththa xeygite; izi ooththida oosota kawoteththata erisite.
He palaappe istti he kawoteththatara geletti ekettidi walakettidanne istta de7o woga kaallida.
Izi salo shaara mayzees; sa7as ira bukisees; zumata bollaka maata mokisees.
Hessa gishshas ammanoy beettizay yootiza qaala siyeththana; yootettiza qaalaykka Kirstoosa gishshas yootiza qaalaappe.
